title: Timeouts and 5xx on payment-api
description: On-call report: error budget burn on payment-api; 9.9% of requests failing at peak and some requests timing out.
root_cause_detail: An error path introduced in payment-api v3.30.0 did not return connections to the pool; the pool (max 30) saturated gradually and requests queued until the acquisition timeout.
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in payment-api logs
payment-api p95 latency rises from ~182ms to ~5.9s
payment-api memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
utilization climbs gradually after deployment of payment-api v3.30.0
resolution: Rolled back payment-api to v3.29.1, fixed the missing connection release and enabled pool leak detection.
